rules.rule: merge rules v2 (性能优化 2026-10-26 07:30Z, susu 07:26Z): a checkpoint is a cumulative gate run, head = next_cpp26, anchor = the previous checkpoint; it is judged by the ordinary formal and SLG rules. At freeze the binaries of every first-parent commit between them are built and stored (--bisect), so a failing checkpoint is bisected in the same session
rules.points: anchor, the listed commits oldest first, head; consecutive points whose binaries of the failed part(s) are identical collapse into the earliest one (a point identical to the anchor or the head takes its value without timing)
rules.step: the middle point between lo and hi (culprit in (lo, hi]) is frozen as a full gate directory bisect-<k> (head = that point, anchor = the checkpoint anchor); only the failed part(s) are timed: one formal batch and/or one SLG group, under the same start, environment and replacement rules
rules.decision: failed metrics = gate phases (formal) or scenarios A-C (SLG) whose checkpoint pooled upper bound is above pass_le and whose geometric mean is above 1; r = log geo of the checkpoint, m = log geo of the step; f = sum(m*r) / sum(r*r); f >= 0.5 -> the culprit is in (lo, mid], otherwise in (mid, hi]
rules.spread: a failed metric with its own m/r in (0.25, 0.75) is reported as possibly spread over several merges
rules.deferred: 性能优化 2026-10-26 12:10Z: a point listed as COMMIT|LABEL is deferred: its binaries are built only when the bisection picks it as the middle point (bisect-supply), so a passing checkpoint builds nothing. A deferred point never collapses with its neighbours; once supplied, binaries identical to the anchor or the head still give its value without timing, so a build costs no timed step
rules.result: hi = lo + 1 -> the culprit is the earliest commit of point hi; after max_steps the remaining range is reported
rules.non_monotone: 性能优化 2026-10-26 19:31Z (INT2: D5 regressed B, P4 recovered B and added C; f followed C and named P4): a step is non-monotone when a failed metric has its own m/r above 1.5 or below -0.5, or when the failed metrics fall on both sides of 0.5 and their m/r differ by 1 or more. The bisection still follows f, but a bisection with a non-monotone step names no single culprit: status non_monotone, every failed metric with its own side at the first such step, and the point f ends at; 性能优化 decides
